+# Adapted from typing-inspection: typing_inspection/introspection.py
+def is_typealiastype(tp: Any) -> bool:
+    """Return whether `tp` is a PEP 695 `TypeAliasType` instance (or its typing_extensions counterpart)."""
+    tp_type = type(tp)
+    return tp_type.__name__ == "TypeAliasType" and tp_type.__module__ in (
+        "typing",
+        "typing_extensions",
+    )
+
+
+def _unwrap_typealiastype(annotation: Any) -> Any:
+    while is_typealiastype(annotation):
+        annotation = annotation.__value__
+    return annotation
+
+

I added PEP 695 `TypeAliasType` support in `fastapi/_compat/shared.py`: a vendored `is_typealiastype` check, plus unwrapping of `__value__` at the entry points of the annotation classifiers. A quick check showed a `TypeAliasType` wrapping a BaseModel classifies as complex and one wrapping `list[int]` as a scalar sequence, and the existing body-params tests pass (102 passed).
